_note: id -> file. Buildings: d072 chosen by Denis 26.09 (d045 kept for comparison). Sprite sheets: horizontal strips, frame rects and tags in the .json next to them (Aseprite json-array). Finni: ChatGPT-based looks (4 per species) replace the code-drawn draft (Denis 26.09: closer to ChatGPT). Room sprites are sized so Finni (~110 px) stands at 'finni' slot. Pets are cleaned on a coarser grid (--px 13/15) so their pixels match Finni's. HI-RES (28.09, 'not pixel-y — hard on their eyes'): defaults now point to assets/hires/, built by tools/hires_art.py from the 27.09 ChatGPT uploads. Density is in the file name: name@4x.png = 4 source px per logical px; the app shows it at px/density and downscales with FilterQuality.medium. size_px / frame_px of hi-res entries are LOGICAL px. Old low-res files stay as 'lowres'/'variants' for fallback. Rooms by growth stage: village = upload #30 left half (empty room: mattress, boxes — Finni just moved in), town = #30 right half (the same room furnished: bed, desk, rug — so the progress reads as 'same room, furnished'), moscow = #31 right half (furnished room with a bigger city behind the window). Still low-res: finni-a3 (hamster, no hi-res upload), pets hamster/dog/fish/turtle, buildings park/cinema/piggy-bank, room 'home' (old horizontal room, kept for onboarding fallback).
